label: Judged by AI models only, not checked by people. Reader measures from the WHU reliability study (exploratory presentation of the study's M1 and M2 labels; outside H1 and H2).
chatgpt_note: ChatGPT performed no web search on WHU-S05 to WHU-S08 (0 searches, 0 citations; deviations 2026-10-26): every one of its S05-S08 sampled sentences is uncited. Its totals are given for all eight and for S01-S04 only.
perplexity_note: Exploratory add-on (perplexity_plan.md): WHU-S01 to WHU-S04 only; compare it with the other systems' S01-S04 totals.

views.averaged: two-judge combined: each item split equally among the judges that labelled it

denominators: citation fidelity: n = supported + cited_not_supported + uncited (excluded items counted apart); conclusions: n = conclusions with a usable label

M1.labels: ~/Projects/whu-study-private/scoring/m1/replies{,_ext}/<judge>/<item>.json, field 'label' (first read; replies_repeat not used, as analyse.py)
M1.rules: scripts/analyse.py per_judge_labels, M1_PASS/M1_FAIL/M1_EXCL; results/machine_only/cross_company.py abstract_correct (EVERY rule)
M1.cited_not_supported: label in {Overstates, Understates, Absent, Wrong source, Contradicted}
M1.uncited: item in uncited.json (label UNCITED for both judges)
M1.excluded: label in {Unreachable, INCOMPLETE_SOURCES, NOT_VERIFIABLE_ABSTRACT} or no usable reply (no source held, refused by both)

M2.n: conclusions with a usable label (matches + the three)

provenance.Perplexity: ~/Projects/whu-study-private/scoring/perplexity/m1 and m2, same fields; checked against results/perplexity/perplexity_ai_only.json M1_citation_support / M2_conclusion_calibration .views.<view>.systems.Perplexity.{failures,countable}

reproduces: failures and n per judge and averaged equal results/eight_ai_only.json sets.{all_eight,S01-S04,S05-S08}.{M1,M2}.views.{claude_judge,openai_judge,combined} for every system (checked by this script before writing)
